chunks: And when a Surah is revealed, some of them say, 'Which of you has this increased in faith?' As for those who believe, it increases their faith, and they rejoice.

key_terms.سُورَةٌ: A chapter or surah of the Quran
key_terms.يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ: They rejoice or give glad tidings

ai.seo_question: How do believers and hypocrites differ in their reaction to the revelation of Quranic chapters?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual sensitivity of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful, who view revelation not as a test of status but as a source of divine joy and confirmation. The contrast between the hypocrites' doubt and the believers' glad tidings underscores the concept of 'Iman' as a dynamic, increasing quality rather than a static state, a theme often linked to the purity of the Imams.
